newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian oil price hike pushes prices up by 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indian oil price hike pushes prices up by 20 pct.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said that inflation rate had shot up by 1.2 percent due to the recent hike in domestic oil prices, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported on Monday.
India's inflation rate, measured by the wholesale price index (WPI) was hovering around 4.5 percent before the government hiked oil prices, by about 20 percent, in July this year.
The inflation rate stood at 5.71 percent on August 24 compared to 5.53 percent in the previous week.
